generationInputs.prompt: A vintage-style poster, printed in a limited red-toned palette on a cream background, features a luminous pink donut and an eggplant with a syringe. The poster has a large, bold headline that arches across the top in all caps, reading "SHOTS FIRED, SUGAR CRAVED." Beneath that, a tagline in stylized font states, "A SWEET ESCAPE OR A PRICKLY SITUATION?" The luminous pink donut, appearing almost weightless with a dreamlike, slightly otherworldly quality due to its holographic shimmer, has tiny, brightly colored, almost translucent sprinkles scattered across its icing. Its base is a barely visible, soft golden hue. Next to the donut, an eggplant holds a syringe. Both subjects appear as stylized, engraved illustrations in the center of the poster, looking slightly off to the side with neutral or sassy expressions. A few mid-century sparkle or starburst icons are scattered around the headline. The poster is finished with a funny footer line or two at the bottom, in a retro vintage font.
